title: A payer’s answer kept apart from the contract documents
assertion: A response naming a document still in intake, held, a duplicate, a zip or one of its entries, of a kind other than a payer letter or other document, of another practice, or a contract version’s source is refused on the letter with one sentence, and nothing is recorded; the letters offered are grouped, those no response names first, then this case’s responses’, then other cases’, and a response with another case’s letter is still recorded; a letter a response names leaves Documents to tag and Documents awaiting abstraction, and tagging it, or naming it in an amendment or a correction, is refused with what to tag instead; a tag and a response of the same letter at the same time cannot both pass; a payer’s terms letter that no response names stays in both lists; the Contracts panel names its payer letter kind a payer’s terms or policy letter and says where a payer’s answer goes
noFileReason: Documents the test inserts in each intake state, and a response recorded with one: no file.
